_comment: A stored adversarial corpus for sync protocol v2 (issue #163, item 3).
Each case names one signed inner field and one way it can be malformed:
missing, wrong-typed, or out of range. tests/test_sync_fail_closed.py loads
this file from disk, applies one case to a real exported message's inner
payload, re-seals it with the sender's real identity and real pairing key,
and asserts import_messages raises AND leaves the recipient's CRDT document
byte-identical -- the property docs/sync-threat-model.md states as 'A
validation failure cannot partially merge the message's CRDT state.'
Stated limit: these are stored *mutations*, not stored sealed envelope
bytes. A committed .hsync blob would require committing the recipient's
private key, which this repository will not carry; the mutation is the part
that is frozen on disk, the crypto around it is live. See the module
'op' is 'delete' (remove the key) or 'replace' (set it to 'value').
